title: Insufficient input validation in `CrowdSale` configuration
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as it can lock up valuable tokens almost permanently  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires a fat-finger or a big configuration error  ## Description  There are two flaws in the configuration validation of a new `CrowdSale`. It is currently possible to create a never ending `Sale` as the `closingTime` field does not have a max value check. It is also possible that a never ending lock or a 0 duration lock is used in `VestedCrowdSale` as the `cliff` argument of `startSale` is not validated as in `StakedVestedCrowdSale::startSale`.
